description: The Chakravyuha after Abhimanyu has penetrated to the core. The formation has collapsed inward. Abhimanyu fights alone, surrounded, with no escape. This is the death scene.

KAURAVA.note: All six Maharathis plus supporting units encircle Abhimanyu.

directive_notes.note: Abhimanyu's death is canonical. The player's goal is to fight valiantly, not to survive.

special_mechanics.surrounded: Abhimanyu is outnumbered 6:1 at Maharathi level plus dozens of supporting units. This is designed to be unwinnable.
special_mechanics.trigger_death: When Abhimanyu HP = 0, trigger-abhimanyu-death fires seq_abhimanyu_death VNScene.
